verdict.rationale: Obsidian's first-party Sync add-on documents version history that lets users view or restore previous versions of a note (obsidian-docs-28, obsidian-docs-37). Nothing in the pack covers recovering deleted notes, and the feature depends on the paid Sync service. missing for 10: documented deleted-note recovery, in-depth docs on version history depth/retention and UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
